title: Script PC MOBILE
features:
KESICI HUB x RIVALS v1.0 - Features & System Architecture

🛡️ Custom Security & Key System: The script is strictly locked against unauthorized access. To run it, you must enter the exclusive Key (kesicihubxrivalsv1) provided in our Discord server. It also features a built-in security wall (Anti-Xeno Kill-Switch) that instantly detects and halts execution on weak or unsupported executors like "Xeno".

🎯 "True Rage" Hardware Aimlock: Instead of outdated camera-forcing systems (CFrame), this hub uses a next-gen engine that directly simulates your mouse hardware (mousemoverel). When you set the aim speed to "10" (Rage), it trashes all smoothing calculations and snaps to the target's head with zero-delay and pixel-perfect accuracy.

👁️ FPS-Friendly Smart ESP (Max Distance): Prevents screen clutter and lag. To avoid FPS drops when the lobby and 1v1 arenas overlap, we integrated a "Max Distance" limit. It only renders the boxes, names, and skeletons of enemies within your specified radius.

🤝 Aggressive Team Check (Deep Scan): Built with a custom scanner to bypass Rivals' hidden team assignment mechanics. It deeply scans hidden properties (Attributes and hidden values) inside players. This ensures your aimbot NEVER snaps to your teammate in 2v2s or team matches—it only hunts real enemies.

📱 Full Mobile Compatibility & Aggressive Theme: The UI is designed in a compact (300x350) and scrollable layout, ensuring it never overflows on mobile screens. It can be toggled via the on-screen "K" logo or the "Right Shift" key on PC. The menu rocks an aggressive "Crimson Red & Charcoal" theme tailored for the competitive spirit of Rivals.
